toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_list
toolsAdded.description: List the board: spec summaries + a paginated page of task cards (no body). Filter by `specId`/`column`; page with `limit`/`offset` (response has `total`+`hasMore`). `verbose:true` adds bodies. Archived excluded unless `includeArchived`.

includeArchived.description: Include archived specs and their tasks. Default false.

verbose.description: Include each task body. Default false (cards only).

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_list_specs
toolsAdded.description: List specs only: id, title, archived flag, per-column task counts (no tasks/bodies). Cheapest "what specs exist?" query. Archived excluded unless `includeArchived`.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_get_task
toolsAdded.description: Return one task in detail, including its thread and sub-agent log.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_update_task
toolsAdded.description: Edit a task; omitted fields are left untouched. Editing `dependsOn` re-evaluates the block state (clearing the last unmet dep unblocks; adding an unmet one blocks).

specId.description: Reassign the task to another spec (S-n).

dependsOn.description: Full replacement set of dependency task ids (T-n). Pass [] to clear all.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_archive_spec
toolsAdded.description: Archive (logical-delete) a spec: hidden from the board/lists, kept on disk, reopenable. Refused if the spec has open (non-done) tasks unless `force: true`.

force.description: Archive even if some tasks are still open. Default false.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_reopen_spec
toolsAdded.description: Reverse kanban_archive_spec — the spec reappears in the board and the listing tools.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_move_task
toolsAdded.description: Move a task to a column: backlog | todo | in_progress | done.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_comment
toolsAdded.description: Post a progress note to a task thread (the user sees it live).

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_request_user_input
toolsAdded.description: Block a task and ask the user a question. It stays blocked until the user replies — stop working on it after calling this.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_record_subagent
toolsAdded.description: Log that you delegated this task to a named sub-agent.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__devia_kanban__kanban_close_task
toolsAdded.description: Mark a task done, optionally linking the closing commit sha.
